static int up_grid(const up_rec_t *r) { return r->ver == 3u || r->ver == UP_VER_GRID; }

#define CPAL_COLS (&favorites.factory[14][8])          /* (22 bytes: 5 + UI_NTRK colours) */

static void motion_reset(track_t *t) { motion_clear(t); }

static uint32_t host_dim_lo;                      /* hal/fm1_input.h: the glow MENU > LEDS asked for (1: DIM LO) */
static void fm1_led_dim_level(uint32_t lo) { host_dim_lo = lo; }

/* the engine byte of DUMP / RELOAD / TRACK */
static uint32_t ed_eng(const track_t *t) { return t->eng_req % NENGINES; }

/* .. one of the user's: a launch, not a song's or a chain's own next */
static int user_staged(uint32_t k) { return chain_go[k % NTRK] || (launch_q[k % NTRK].armed && !launch_q[k % NTRK].adv); }

/* the UI: OCT UP / DN is the buffer effect playing (KNOB 4 is its shimmer, the card says so) */
static int perf_harm_on(void) { return (PF_HARM >> perf_pick(perf_act)) & 1u; }

#define MR_LX 16                                       /* its label */
#define MR_VR 224                                      /* its value's right edge */
#define MK_Y 224                                       /* the key hints */
static int menu_large(void) { return (ui_prefs & PREF_LARGE) != 0u; }

/* a value's gauge, 0..1000 over d's range (-1: no range); (Skiff 2.0) a call, not a divide at every card */
static int32_t ratio_of(const param_desc_t *d, int32_t v) { return d->max > d->min ? (v - d->min) * 1000 / (d->max - d->min) : -1; }
static uint32_t drum_kit_plays(int32_t v) { return DK_PLAYS[clamp(v, 0, DK_COUNT - 1)]; }
static void fm_op_knob(uint32_t k, int32_t s) { fm_knob(0, k, s); }
static void fm_all_knob(uint32_t k, int32_t s) { fm_knob(1, k, s); }
